title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.805656458376: grouped hash-chain early abort, 256-record blocks, 46-bit d4

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins, the Chen-Stein method on cross-node leaf pairs bounds P(no collision), and drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the enumerated carry sites of section 3.4 and the caps of two meters are charged failure rows (section 6, in success.md). Its expected total work is at most 2^124.805656458376 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit; certificate.py gives at most 269.0935 per leaf), E-averaged over 32 X-groups stopping at the first resolving group with prefix non-stopping bounds; same-key records join order-free by hash chains (each group call reads its slots from per-slot read cursors to E2 and advances the cursors, so every record links exactly once to its most recent same-K2-same-d4 predecessor in a cumulative table over 2^57 zeroed heads linked by a packed next-array with one 8-byte next word per R2 slot position (every receive pattern up to the slot caps covered by construction); walks are uncapped and run to the first full match or the chain end, so there is no overflow event; main-pair walks are charged by history-conditional KB(129) pair counting times PHI[g] with same-X pairs carved out globally and defective-run hash work allowed globally at unconditional d_batch); worst-case work on every run is at most 2^188.604987 instructions (HOME_MAX visits per record), disclosed. Each pair of generator points X, Y gives six leaves, the x-coordinates of phi^t(X) +- Y for t = 0, 1, 2, from one batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2, held as their discrete Fourier transform: with a = x_X, b = x_Y, E = b^4 + 2a^3 b, F = a^4 + 2ab^3, G = 3a^2 b^2 and w = 1/(y_Y +- y_X)^2, the leaves are (Ew - b) + beta^t (Fw - a) + beta^(2t) Gw, and only the six components Ew, Fw, Gw are computed (section 3.1). A class's label is the top 100 bits of v*/p and (beta v* mod p)/p, v* = min(x, beta x, beta^2 x); each leaf's fractions are sums of its components' fractions with stored correction words, within [-73, 73], [-73, 206] and [-212, 146] at 128 bits, and a leaf in the window set W or the label-error set D' (rates below 2^-58.47 and 2^-17.38 per leaf) is a charged missed collision (section 3.3); a lattice count bounds a box of label values at 1 + 2^-18 times its share. Records go in blocks of k = 256 (2^14 stride, TBZ slot test, flush 8, dlvk 1026) over two hops (emit 7, h2s 7.25) with hash-chain grouping at a 46-bit d4 (sections 2.1, 4); every delivery is charged as executed route.s code and links keep no state. Peak memory at most 2^135.9989 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^118.3566 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks the declared figures. Credits are in section 9 and the declared dependencies; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. This is an analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points against exact arithmetic (components, the Fourier identity, records against a bit-exact model of keys, indices and labels outside W and D') and the class-rule and class-label tests; the emit, both hops (each message delivered by executing dlv or dlvk) and the grouping on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py); the grouped next-array hash-chain early-abort run with stop, full and full-list cases on the true cumulative layout with read cursors (grouped_paths); the sites and fixups of section 3.4 (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
